note: Reconstructed from the saved results in commit 9ee502e: the run's own record names its url, its state list and every part of every root, and this config restates those. `states` is `base` alone, because the alert has no interactive state of its own; its one link is a behaviour check. The size row is measured with the previews stretched, matching the reference's own demo row (`flex ... items-stretch`), so a small alert reads the tallest sibling's height on both sides. That stretch reaches our root only because the host stands aside with `display: contents`; a host box of ours would absorb it.
